title: FactRegistry entry (World fact)
description: Stores only WORLD facts (objective facts about the world). Derived facts are not stored -- they are recomputed on the fly by the deterministic rule evaluator from World facts according to constraints (see the derived required_fact in golden_packet). Missing facts go into a separate GapRegistry; conflict relations go into a separate ConflictRegistry (see the $defs notes at the end of the file).

fact_key.description: Globally stable key, used for cross-sample dedup/reuse

layer.description: only world facts are stored; the derived/task layers store no ground truth

conditions.description: used by conditional_rule/threshold. key=variable, value=constant or comparison-operator object

_sibling_registries.GapRegistry: A gap is not a world truth and is stored separately: {gap_id, missing_slot:{domain,object,attribute}, scope, checked_against:[FactRegistry,SpanMap,AuditRetrievers], status: unanswerable_verified|_uncertain|_failed}. Distinguishes four states: KB has no answer / policy forbidden / policy allowed / conflict.
_sibling_registries.ConflictRegistry: Conflicts are stored separately: {conflict_id, conflict_type: intentional|accidental, facts:[fact_id], resolution_rule, used_by_samples:[]}. A conflict without a conflict_id = accidental -> fail validation.
